Anthropic provides pre-built Agent Skills for common document tasks (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, PDF), and you can create your own custom Skills. Both work the same way: once a Skill is available in your environment, Claude uses it automatically when relevant to your request.

name: Equipping Agents for the Real World with Agent Skills
snippet:
Think of Agent Skills as little knowledge packages that transform general-purpose Claude into a specialized assistant for your specific needs.
Anthropic is continuing to develop the Skills ecosystem, with plans to add features for creating, editing, discovering, sharing, and using ... Read more
Instead of cramming everything into your prompts or building custom agents from scratch for each use case, you can now create modular, reusable skills that Claude can tap into as needed.
